steps.title: Arrange sample racks and plate
steps.instruction: Place urine samples in four-tube racks to mirror the 96‑well plate layout, include 15 column controls, start pick‑off from tube D2 (rack slot 1) corresponding to well H2 (plate slot 3).

steps.title: Configure run parameters
steps.instruction: Set the following parameters: use CSV file if provided, specify number of samples (1‑81), tip withdrawal speed, sample aspiration height (mm) for both aspiration and dispense, and assign the P300 single‑channel pipette to the left or right mount.

steps.title: Add enzyme hydrolysis solution
steps.instruction: Using a single‑channel pipette, dispense 60 µL of Enzyme Hydrolysis Solution from a 15 mL conical tube into each well that contains a sample.

steps.title: Transfer urine samples
steps.instruction: Aspirate 50 µL of urine from each sample tube and dispense into the corresponding well of the 96‑well block, using a fresh tip for each sample.

steps.title: Incubate enzyme reaction
steps.instruction: Delay for 30 minutes after the enzyme hydrolysis solution has been added to the last well.

steps.title: Add trichloroacetic acid
steps.instruction: Using a single‑channel pipette, add 20 µL of Trichloroacetic Acid solution from a 15 mL conical tube to each well containing a sample.

steps.title: Manual shake block
steps.instruction: Pause the run until manually resumed after shaking the plate block.

steps.title: Add dilution buffer
steps.instruction: Using a single‑channel pipette, add 150 µL of Dilution Buffer to each well containing a sample.
